audience: developers who issue and manage API keys, identities and rate limits with Unkey

useCases.title: Look up a key and its settings
useCases.text: The AI fetches a key by id, or identifies a key from its secret without spending credits, and shows its name, owner, permissions, credits, rate limits and enabled state.

useCases.title: List the keys of an API or of one customer
useCases.text: The AI lists the keys issued under one API, optionally narrowed to a single customer by externalId.

useCases.title: Count passed and failed key checks in a period
useCases.text: The AI runs a read-only SQL query over key-verification analytics, for example the last seven days, and summarizes how many checks passed or failed.

useCases.title: Review identities, roles and permissions
useCases.text: The AI lists identities and opens one with its metadata and shared rate limits, and lists the roles and permissions defined in your workspace.

useCases.title: Issue, change or revoke an API key
useCases.text: The AI creates a key under an API, updates its name, owner, expiry, roles or enabled state, adjusts its credits, or revokes it.
